items.title: Observability & Monitoring
items.description: Comprehensive guide to observability in distributed systems covering the three pillars (metrics, logs, traces), SLOs, alerting strategies, and Spring Boot Actuator + Micrometer setup.

items.title: Platform Delivery, Edge Caching & Modern CI/CD Reliability
items.description: Deep dive into modern web delivery and platform reliability — Edge Anycast routing, surrogate-key cache invalidation, automated Canary gates, SSG to SSR/ISR migration, atomic versioned S3/CloudFront deployments, CI/CD build pipelines, zero-downtime data migrations, SLO error budget burn rates, and OpenTelemetry observability fundamentals.
